text:
Ella: Quick check — I'm picking up the errref thread to consolidate localized cURL + SDK snippets for 429s, timeouts, and context-fallbacks. I opened PR #6248 on docs-staging. Scope: one curated curl per language, ctx-clipping example, migration note for SDK retry header change. Can folks eyeball?
Sam: Sounds good. Are we switching recommended backoff to exponential + full jitter in the examples?
Maria: Yes please. Also add a tiny note about Dedicated behavior: how the routing may fall back to a lower-seq-length variant. We need a curl example showing model variant param.
Kev: Pinged eng-runtime for a quick confirmation on the variant names. @Ella can you add a link to the routing/runtime policy in the draft?
Ella: Added the runtime policy link in the draft and a placeholder for a small migration table. Example curl block (needs escaping check):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium-1","prompt":"Summarize...","retries":"auto","variant":"low_latency"}'
```
Sam: Minor nit — label that example as a "fail-fast" troubleshooting snippet and also include a streaming example that demonstrates how timeouts manifest (e.g., truncated stream + X-Stream-Interrupted header).
Maria: For SDKs: update python snippet to show client.generate_with_retry(backoff='exponential_jitter', max_retries=5) and a short JS equivalent. Then show how to map that to curl for customers doing repros.
Kev: Added a runtime note about context clipping: service returns X-Context-Truncated when we evict KV/prefix context; recommend trimming prompt or using prefix caching. Suggested snippet: 
```python
# trim older assistant turns before sending
client.generate(prompt=trimmed_prompt, max_tokens=256)
```
Deploy-bot: PR #6248 merged to docs-staging at 7098765450 :rocket:
Ella: Great — can someone sanity-check the cross-links? I also want a one-paragraph migration note for old SDK header X-Retry -> Retry-Mode and the new semantics (server-side vs client-side retries).
Sam: I'll run link-check and flag any broken anchors. Also propose adding a repro command for 429s customers can run locally: `ab -n 200 -c 10 https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate` and a note to watch X-RateLimit-* headers.
Maria: LGTM. One more: include a tiny ASCII troubleshooting flow: 
1) Check rate-limit headers -> 2) Backoff + jitter -> 3) Fallback to model variant -> 4) Contact support + paste request-id.
Kev: Runtime side approved. Left two inline comments about exact variant token limits.
Ella: Thanks all — I'll address comments, backport the curl/SDK snippets to the 429-playbook page, and cut a follow-up PR to add the migration blurb. ETA: tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
